lines.raw: §7Every year, Shen is auctioning three special accessories to those he deems popular enough to deserve his items.
lines.text: Every year, Shen is auctioning three special accessories to those he deems popular enough to deserve his items.
lines.zh: 每年，Shen 都会拍卖三件特殊饰品，只有他认可的人气之士才有资格获得。

lines.context: 三台计算机服务器采集；按同次 Lore 核对。
lines.raw: §7Shen is auctioning two more special edition items to the richest of the rich this year!
lines.text: Shen is auctioning two more special edition items to the richest of the rich this year!
lines.zh: 今年，Shen 还将额外拍卖两件特别版物品，专供富豪中的富豪竞拍！
